messages.subject: [statnet_help] Re: a question on statnet
messages.body_plain:
Dear Svetlana,

The "statnetuserterms" package is available on the "statnet" website:

Go to  http://www.csde.washington.edu/statnet

Click on "Online User's Guide" and then the "Adding New Terms to the
Package" link.

There are detailed directions on that page, including a link to the source
code for the package.

On the second issue: The "sender" and "receiver" model adds one statistic
for each actor's activity and one for each attractiveness. For that model
the "edges" term is redundant and should be omitted.

Please make sure you are using the latest version of "statnet".

Regards,

Mark

p.s. It may be a good idea to subscribe to the "statnet_help" mailing list.
You can subscribe from
https://mailman1.u.washington.edu/mailman/listinfo/statnet_help

-------------------------------------------------

messages.subject: [statnet_help] Feature Request
messages.body_plain:
Hi Statnet List,

I heard there had been a suggestion passed your way awhile back for a 
few feature requests, including a "Force MCMC" parameter and the ability 
to extract objects from the summary.ergm command (i.e. summary.ergm can 
return objects from the output it prints).  By a "Force MCMC" parameter 
I mean a feature that can force ergm to use the MCMC, even if the model 
has no dependence terms, so that I can use the proposal constraints.  
Additionally, I've noticed a bug where I cannot extracting the AIC 
through ergm.object$aic when I use the triangle parameter.

Has there been any improvements or modifications to these features?  I 
understand all contribution to statnet is entirely voluntary so any help 
on these matters would be greatly appreciated.

Thanks for putting together such a useful package.

-Ben
